items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, Calvin. He played the guitar. I forget what -- I think Phineas’s uncle might have been a drummer or something.

ctx.x: Oh, Calvin. He played the guitar. I forget what -- I think Phineas’s uncle might have been a drummer or something. All manner of musicians came in there. I became known as the soldier boy when I was able to stand toe to toe with Dexter and not be blown away.
I read this. What was the tune that he called?
